notes: Summary retains phase histograms, client quantiles, connection observations and resource peaks, not full raw resource time series.
Initial backend counting did not distinguish non-client backends. Observer naming alone did not cure this. The origin of old unlabelled rows cannot be established retrospectively.
Final client-only filtering repeats the full 160/s cell three times for both topologies. Selected older runs had no connection-guard stops.
Quiet/hot criteria were explicitly checked when assembling this summary; they agree with the recorded verdicts.
client_inflight_limit means the generator never sent the scheduled command. It is not a server rejection.
Recovery attempts are serial and stop when the measurement window ends; unattempted observations are not actual recovery errors.
